title: Anthropic’s valuation can’t secure its moat
summary: Its engineers need to keep building progressively more capable models; the AI firm has also not established that it will be able to sustain its profitability after honouring its infra commitments
llm_summary: Anthropic’s lofty valuation hinges on its ability to keep releasing ever‑more powerful AI models, but the company hasn’t yet proven it can do so profitably while covering its hefty infrastructure costs. In short, the firm’s “moat” – its competitive edge – remains uncertain until it shows it can sustain growth and earnings despite massive spending commitments.
